info.name: MW Realty — Customer App API
info.description: The endpoints the MW Realty customer app calls, by app tab: Entry, Home, Search, Saved, Activity, Account.

item.name: Entry
item.description: First launch: pick a language, then continue as a guest or sign in. Guests can search, view properties and send enquiries; Saved, Activity and Account need a signed-in user.

request.description: The languages content is available in. Send the chosen `code` as `?lang=` on every request.

Prices from every endpoint are in AED; to display another currency, multiply by its `rate`
(units per 1 AED).

Static UI copy (labels, buttons…) as a key → text map for one language. Cache it on the
device per language.

Step 1 of sign-up. Creates the account and emails a 4-digit code — no token yet; call
`POST /api/auth/verify-otp` with the returned `user_id` and the code.
`email_sent: false` means the email failed — offer "Resend code".

response.body: {"message": "The email has already been taken.", "errors": {"email": ["The email has already been taken."]}}
response.name: Validation error

request.description:
Step 2 of sign-up: the 4-digit code emailed by `POST /api/auth/register`. Marks the
email verified and returns a Bearer token.

response.body: {"message": "Could not send the code right now — please try again in a moment."}

request.description: Email + password sign-in. Returns a Bearer token for the `Authorization` header.

Exchange the access token from the native Google Sign-In SDK for an app token. Links to an
existing account with the same email, or creates one. For the **User** account only —
agents and agencies don't have Google sign-in (show the button only on the User tab).

Emails a reset link (opens the website's reset page). Always the same reply, whether or not
the email is registered.

response.body: {"message": "If an account exists for that email, a reset link has been sent."}

request.description:
Only needed if the app handles the reset link itself (deep link
`/reset-password?token=...&email=...`); otherwise the website page does this.

response.body: {"message": "Your password has been reset — you can now sign in."}

request.description: Revokes the token used for this request (other devices stay signed in).

Is someone signed in, and which property ids are in their wishlist (to draw the heart
icons). Works without a token too — guests get `authenticated: false` instead of a 401.

Public — every page's shared session state (useWishlist.js) calls this once on load.

item.name: Home
item.description:
Buy / Rent / Commercial / New Projects switch, the search bar, recently viewed and latest listings. **Recently viewed** has no endpoint: keep the last viewed property cards on the phone.

**Also uses (connected):**

* `GET /api/location-suggestions` — see **Search**
* `GET /api/properties` — see **Search**
* `GET /api/commercial` — see **Search**

request.description:
Every home section in one request: banner, brands, ad, developments, premium properties,
luxury, why-choose-us, communities, popular places, testimonials, contact. Property lists
inside are shuffled on each call.

`ad` is a single ad, kept for older clients. The home ad slider shows every running ad:
load it from **Ad slider** (`/api/ads/slides?placement=home`).

query.description: A city tab from the home response.

request.description: The home "Browse New Projects" section's listings for one city tab.

item.name: Search
item.description:
Location search, the results list and map, filters, and the property details screen (contact, viewing, mortgage).

**Also uses (connected):**

* `POST /api/customer/wishlist/{property}` — see **Saved**
* `POST /api/customer/saved-searches` — see **Saved**

query.description: Whose listings the counts/bounds come from: residential, commercial, premium, marketing.

request.description:
The filters to render (selects with their options and live listing counts, number sliders
with min/max/step), in admin order. Pass the chosen `value`s back to the listing endpoints
under each filter's `key`.

Key-value: `filters` is keyed by each filter's key, and every option list is `{ value: label }`.
Send the picked values back to the listing endpoint under the filter's `param` (or `params.min`
/ `params.max` for a range). Checkbox filters (`multiple: true`) take several values,
comma-separated. `order` / `options_order` give the admin's order.

Cities, communities and addresses matching what the user typed (2+ characters; fewer
returns an empty list). Pass a picked suggestion back as `city=` / `community=` /
`location=` on the listing endpoints. Debounce on the client — limited to 120 calls/minute.

query.description: Purpose: sale, rent or off_plan. e.g. `rent`.

request.description: Commercial listings (16 per page) — same response shape as `GET /api/properties`.

query.description: Purpose: sale, rent or off_plan. e.g. `sale`.
Exact city from a location suggestion. e.g. `Dubai`.
Exact community from a location suggestion. e.g. `Dubai Marina`.
Amenity values from the filters endpoint.
recent, price_asc, price_desc or popular. e.g. `recent`.
1 = featured (premium) listings only, residential + commercial. e.g. `0`.
An agent's slug — only their listings.
An agency's slug — only its listings.
1 = only listings with upcoming open house days.

request.description:
Residential listings (16 per page) with the result count, pagination and the card data for
each listing. Filter keys and values come from `GET /api/property-filters`; any admin
select filter whose key is a property column also works as `?{key}=value`.

query.description: Viewport bounds — all four or none. e.g. `25.05`.

request.description:
Pins for the map view. Takes every filter of `GET /api/properties` (or of
`/api/commercial` with `segment=commercial`), plus the visible map area. Send the bounds
of the current viewport after each pan/zoom.

variable.description: The listing slug from a property card.

request.description:
The full listing: gallery, price, specs, description, amenities, location, agent/agency
contact, floor plans, open house days, similar listings and SEO. Use the property's `id`
from here for wishlist and lead endpoints.
Page copy, enquiry-form copy, FAQs, settings and SEO of one calculator.

body.raw: {"property_id":111,"name":"Sara Ahmed","email":"buyer@example.com","phone":"501234567","phone_country_code":"+971","company":"mniihfqcoynlazghdtqtq","country":"xbajwbpilpmufinllwloa","message":"Is this still available? I'd like to view it this week.","page_source":"mobile-app"}

request.description:
"Contact agent" form on a listing — goes to the listing's agent/agency CRM. If a customer
token is sent, the enquiry also appears under their account.

response.body: {"message": "Thanks — your enquiry has been received and we'll be in touch soon."}

request.description:
A property lead (same routing as an enquiry) with the requested day + time slot. If the
listing has open house days (`available_dates` on the property details), only those days
are accepted; otherwise any day from today up to 60 days ahead.

response.body: {"message": "Thanks — your viewing request for Thursday, 15 Oct 2026, Afternoon (12 PM – 4 PM) has been sent. The agent will confirm with you shortly.", "when": "Thursday, 15 Oct 2026, Afternoon (12 PM – 4 PM)"}
{"message": "Please pick one of the open house days for this property.", "errors": {"viewing_date": ["Please pick one of the open house days for this property."]}}

request.description: The user tapped a contact button on a listing (before the call/WhatsApp/email app opens).

item.name: Saved
item.description:
Saved properties and saved searches. Signed-in users only.

**Also uses (connected):**

* `GET /api/customer/me` — see **Activity**
* `GET /api/properties` — see **Search**

request.description: The saved properties as listing cards, newest first, 16 per page.
Adds the property to the wishlist, or removes it if it's already there.

Stores the listing filters so the user can reopen them later. `criteria` takes the same
keys as the `GET /api/properties` query string.

response.body: {"id": 3, "title": "2BR in Marina", "meta": "Dubai Marina · 2 Bed · For sale · AED 1,500,000 – any", "criteria": {"location": "Dubai Marina", "bedrooms": "2", "listing_type": "sale", "min_price": 1500000}}

item.name: Activity
item.description: Enquiries and viewing requests the user sent, with their status, and the recent activity feed. Signed-in users only.

request.description:
Everything for the account screen in one call: profile, counts, recent activity, the
wishlist (property cards), saved searches and sent enquiries. For long wishlists, use the
paginated `GET /api/customer/wishlist` instead.

response.body: {"profile": {"name": "Sara Ahmed", "email": "buyer@example.com", "phone": "+971 50 123 4567", "location": "Dubai Marina", "avatar_url": null}, "stats": {"wishlist": 2, "saved_searches": 1, "enquiries": 1}, "activity": [{"icon": "heart.svg", "text": "You saved \"Marina Gate 2BR\" to your wishlist.", "time": "2 hours ago"}], "wishlist": [{"id": 12, "slug": "marina-gate-2br", "image": "https://.../photo.jpg", "...": "same card shape as GET /api/properties"}], "saved_searches": [{"id": 3, "title": "2BR in Marina", "meta": "Dubai Marina · 2 Bed · For sale", "criteria": {"location": "Dubai Marina", "bedrooms": "2", "listing_type": "sale"}}], "enquiries": [{"id": 91, "property": "Marina Gate 2BR", "sent_to": "Ahmed Khan", "date": "Oct 08, 2026", "status": "New"}]}

item.name: Account
item.description:
Profile, language and settings; help, privacy and terms; delete account.

**Also uses (connected):**

* `GET /api/customer/me` — see **Activity**
* `GET /api/languages` — see **Entry**
* `POST /api/auth/logout` — see **Entry**

request.description: Office address, phone, email, WhatsApp and social links (the website footer).

formdata.description: Leave out to keep the current password.

request.description:
Send as `multipart/form-data` when uploading an avatar. Use `POST` from the app — PHP does
not parse file uploads on `PUT` (the `PUT` route is kept for the website).

Permanently deletes the account (required by the App Store / Play Store for apps with
sign-up). Wishlist and saved searches are removed; enquiries already sent to agents stay
with them, unlinked from the account. Password accounts must confirm their password;
Google-only accounts send nothing.

response.body: {"message": "The password is incorrect.", "errors": {"password": ["The password is incorrect."]}}

item.name: Background tracking
item.description: Sent in the background, not tied to one tab: screen views, time on a listing and listing impressions. They feed the agents' listing stats and lead insights.

request.description:
Call when a screen opens. Send the **website path** the screen corresponds to — that is
how views are classified: `/property-details/{slug}` = property view (counts towards the
listing's stats and routes the visitor to its agent), `/properties?bedrooms=2&...` = a
search, anything else = a page view. Keep the returned `id` to report time spent.

Requires the `X-Device-Id` header (nothing is recorded without it).

variable.description: The `id` returned by the screen view call.

request.description:
Seconds the screen has been visible so far. Send whenever the screen is left or the app
goes to the background; the largest value wins, so re-sending is safe.

Property cards that were visible on screen. Batch them, and send each id at most once per
day per device.

Listing cards that were on screen (ids, de-duplicated per day by the browser).
